# Procedural generators

Every generator takes `seed` (uint32), an optional `preset`, `params` (below; unknown names are rejected, numbers are clamped with a warning) and an optional `style`. `detail` (0-1) trades triangles for secondary features.

## Styles

| Style | Look |
| :-- | :-- |
| `neutral` | Natural colours, light bevels. The default before a look is chosen. |
| `toy` | Bright, saturated plastic colours, chunky bevels. |
| `storybook` | Soft, warm, slightly muted picture-book colours. |
| `neon` | Dark bodies with glowing cyan and magenta accents. |
| `grim` | Desaturated, dark, weathered. |
| `sci-fi` | Clean whites and greys with teal and orange accents. |
| `shrine` | Stylised Japanese shrine garden: warm grey stone, sakura pink, maple red and moss green, soft flat shading. |

## Budgets (warning lines per role)

Nothing fails a bake on size: above a line the bake warns. Aim for the target at the default detail; voxel models keep their own, larger lines.

| Role | Triangles (warn above) | Target | File (warn above) | Largest extent |
| :-- | --: | --: | --: | :-- |
| hero | 4500 | 2000 | 300 KB | 0.2-4 m |
| boss | 6000 | 3200 | 400 KB | 0.5-12 m |
| landmark | 3000 | 2000 | 350 KB | 0.5-40 m |
| hero-landmark | 6000 | 3500 | 500 KB | 2-120 m |
| enemy | 2500 | 1100 | 180 KB | 0.2-6 m |
| prop | 1500 | 500 | 120 KB | 0.05-20 m |
| vehicle | 5000 | 2500 | 300 KB | 0.3-30 m |
| pickup | 800 | 250 | 80 KB | 0.05-2 m |
| arena | 1000 | 800 | 150 KB | 0.1-40 m |

The catalogue packs (dungeon, village, food, zombies, animals and more) are listed in [packs.md](packs.md); read a pack generator's params with `queryAsset({ operation: 'listGenerators', generator: '<id>' })`.

## `building.simple`

Budget role: prop. A small low-poly building standing on the ground with its door on the front (+Z): a cottage, townhouse, watchtower, log cabin, sci-fi bunker, open market stall or a ruined house. Choose floors, footprint, roof (flat, gable, hip, cone or none), a wall material scheme (plaster, brick, stone, timber, log, scifi, stall), how many windows, a door and a chimney. Raise wear above 0.5 for a ruin: stepped broken walls, a leaning roof slab, charred beams, moss and rubble. For the rim of an arena or a town street pick a kind: shop (striped awning and hanging sign), tall_house (narrow steep-gabled townhouse with dormer), block (3-5 floor flat-roofed city block with a shopfront, parapet and rooftop clutter), tower (slim sci-fi tower with glowing window strips and an antenna) or module (squat sci-fi habitat with a rounded roof, portholes, a side airlock and pipes). Kinds other than house ignore roof, battlements and the ruin look; the walls scheme only recolours shop, tall_house and block.

| Preset | What it is |
| :-- | :-- |
| `cottage` | A one-floor plaster cottage with a gable roof, chimney, front door and two windows. |
| `townhouse` | A two-floor brick townhouse with a gable roof, a door and rows of windows. |
| `watchtower` | A tall square stone watchtower with arrow slits and a crenellated flat top. |
| `market_stall` | An open-fronted wooden market stall with a striped awning roof, a counter and goods. |
| `ruined_house` | A fallen-down stone house: jagged standing walls, a broken door frame, a leaning roof slab, charred beams, moss and rubble. |
| `scifi_bunker` | A low chamfered sci-fi bunker with a flat roof, glowing light strips, a sliding door panel and slit windows. |
| `log_cabin` | A rustic log cabin with stacked logs, a steep gable roof, a chimney and a door. |
| `shop_awning` | A two-floor shop with a wide front window under a striped fabric awning, a hanging sign, a door, planters and a gable roof. |
| `tall_townhouse` | A narrow three-floor townhouse with a steep front gable, a dormer, a chunky chimney and rows of windows. |
| `city_block` | A four-floor flat-roofed city block with a shopfront band and fascia, a regular window grid, a parapet with coping and rooftop water tank, vents and antenna. |
| `neon_tower` | A tall slim sci-fi tower on a wide podium with glowing window strips, a glowing crown ring and a rooftop antenna with a beacon. |
| `outpost_module` | A squat sci-fi habitat module with a rounded ribbed roof, porthole windows, a sliding door, a side airlock with hatch and wall pipes. |

| Param | Type | Range or values | Default |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `kind` | enum | `house`, `shop`, `tall_house`, `block`, `tower`, `module` | `house` |
| `floors` | integer | 1 to 5 | `1` |
| `width` | number | 2.5 to 12 | `5` |
| `depth` | number | 2.5 to 12 | `4` |
| `floorHeight` | number | 2.2 to 3.5 | `2.6` |
| `roof` | enum | `flat`, `gable`, `hip`, `cone`, `none` | `gable` |
| `pitch` | number | 0.2 to 1.2 | `0.55` |
| `walls` | enum | `plaster`, `brick`, `stone`, `timber`, `log`, `scifi`, `stall` | `plaster` |
| `windows` | enum | `none`, `few`, `many` | `few` |
| `door` | enum | `none`, `front` | `front` |
| `chimney` | enum | `none`, `one` | `none` |
| `battlements` | boolean | - | `false` |
| `wear` | number | 0 to 1 | `0` |
| `surface` | enum | `auto`, `vertex`, `painted` | `auto` |
| `detail` | number | 0 to 1 | `0.5` |

## `bush`

Budget role: prop. A chunky low-poly bush or shrub: a clustered lump of clean faceted leaf lobes in two greens, with optional flowers or round berries and short woody stems. Wide or tall, round or spiky, in several leaf and flower colours; variant 0-7 changes the lobe count, adds flowers or berries, and shifts the shape and colourway.

| Preset | What it is |
| :-- | :-- |
| `shrub` | A round green shrub of clustered faceted lobes. |
| `topiary` | A tidy, smooth, ball-shaped hedge bush. |
| `flowering` | A green bush dotted with pink flowers. |
| `berry_bush` | A dark green bush with red berries. |
| `dry_scrub` | A sparse, spiky olive scrub bush with woody stems showing. |

| Param | Type | Range or values | Default |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `size` | number | 0.3 to 3 | `1` |
| `clumps` | integer | 2 to 9 | `5` |
| `spread` | number | 0 to 1 | `0.5` |
| `roundness` | number | 0 to 1 | `0.8` |
| `flowers` | number | 0 to 1 | `0` |
| `flowerColour` | enum | `pink`, `yellow`, `white`, `red`, `blue` | `pink` |
| `leafColour` | enum | `green`, `olive`, `autumn`, `dark`, `fresh` | `green` |
| `stems` | boolean | - | `false` |
| `variant` | integer | 0 to 7 | `0` |
| `surface` | enum | `auto`, `vertex`, `painted` | `auto` |
| `detail` | number | 0 to 1 | `0.5` |

## `plant.species`

Budget role: prop. A plant grammar for any tree, shrub, flower, cactus, mushroom, reed, lily pad, fern, coral, kelp, candy or crystal tree: stems (straight, leaning, twisted, segmented like bamboo, or none; one or a clump), branching 0-3 levels with angle and curl, a canopy primitive (blob, cone, tiers, umbrella, frond, palm, cap, pad, weeping, spire, crystal, gumdrop, ladder of leaves, knobs, block), leaf shape, flowers and fruit, candy / crystal surfaces with patterns, and alive, bare or dead states. Sways as foliage.

| Preset | What it is |
| :-- | :-- |
| `oak` | A broad oak: thick tapered trunk, two levels of limbs and a crown of five faceted lobes in two greens. |
| `pine` | A tall pine: straight dark trunk and three stacked faceted cone tiers. |
| `palm` | A coconut palm: a leaning, ringed trunk with drooping fronds and a cluster of coconuts. |
| `saguaro` | A saguaro cactus: a ribbed column with two upturned arms and rounded tips. |
| `toadstool` | A giant toadstool: a pale stem under a red cap with white spots. |
| `dead_tree` | A dead tree: grey gnarled trunk and broken bare limbs. |
| `reeds` | A clump of reeds with brown cattail heads. |

A turned prop spun from a silhouette profile given as data (radius and height points, bottom to top): urns, paper lanterns, bottles, bollards, square carved totems, braziers on legs, vases, barrels, candles, jars, pots and pillars. Set the form for a ready profile or pass your own `profile`, then the faces around (4 = square, 6 = hex), painted bands `[y0, y1, slot]` (slot 0 body, 1 trim, 2 detail, 3 glow), raised rings, ribs, handles, legs, carved faces and a topper (flame, orb, finial, coals, wick, spike, knob, roof, wings). Colour slots body / trim / detail / glow come from `colors`.

| Preset | What it is |
| :-- | :-- |
| `stone_urn` | A grey stone garden urn with a flared lip and foot. |
| `paper_lantern` | A glowing red paper lantern with dark ribs and caps. |
| `oak_barrel` | A bellied oak barrel with two iron hoops. |
| `fire_brazier` | An iron fire bowl on three legs, heaped with glowing coals and a flame. |
| `carved_totem` | A square carved wooden totem with three stacked faces and spread wings. |
| `candle` | A thick wax candle in a brass dish with a lit wick. |
| `street_bollard` | A dark street bollard with a glowing ring near the top. |

| Param | Type | Range or values | Default |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `form` | enum | `urn`, `lantern`, `bottle`, `bollard`, `totem`, `brazier`, `vase`, `barrel`, `candle`, `jar`, `pot`, `pillar` | `urn` |
| `profile` | array | - | `` |
| `height` | number | 0.1 to 6 | `1` |
| `radius` | number | 0.03 to 2 | `0.35` |
| `sides` | integer | 0 to 24 | `0` |
| `smooth` | integer | 0 to 3 | `1` |
| `squash` | number | 0.4 to 1.6 | `1` |
| `bands` | array | - | `` |
| `relief` | number | 0 to 0.2 | `0.04` |
| `ribs` | integer | 0 to 16 | `0` |
| `ribTop` | number | 0.1 to 1 | `1` |
| `handles` | integer | 0 to 4 | `0` |
| `legs` | integer | 0 to 4 | `0` |
| `faces` | integer | 0 to 4 | `0` |
| `top` | enum | `auto`, `none`, `flame`, `orb`, `finial`, `coals`, `wick`, `spike`, `knob`, `roof`, `wings` | `auto` |
| `mouth` | enum | `auto`, `open`, `closed` | `auto` |

## `prop.sign`

Budget role: prop. A sign: a panel (rect, rounded, arrow, diamond, triangle, circle, shield, banner, or your own outline as data) plus glyph strokes. Neon signs glow as tubes on a dark board; shop signs are painted. Mounts: post, two posts, wall bracket, hanging from a bracket, A-frame stand, rooftop frame or a pole. ## `prop.wall`

Budget role: prop. One wall segment running along X that tiles end to end: it spans X from -length/2 to length/2 with flush ends, stands on Y = 0 and keeps its centreline on Z = 0 (step by the length to continue a wall). Finishes: dry stone, brick, timber palisade, hedge, sci-fi barrier panels with a glow strip, or a mossy ruin; with coping or caps on top so they read from above. ## `rock.cliff`

Budget role: prop. ## `structure.kit`

Budget role: prop. A building from a grammar, door on the front (+Z): footprint (rect, L, round, octagon, or a plan outline given as data) x 1-4 storeys (optionally tapering) x roof (gable, hip, pagoda with eave skirts, dome or onion from a profile given as data, flat with a parapet, thatch, cone, or a flat roof carrying a glowing neon sign) x facade modules (windows square / arched / round / slit / shoji / strip, doors plain / arched / double / round / sliding, balconies, a shopfront with fascia and striped awning, an arcade of arches) x trim (corner posts, floor bands, half-timbering, icing drips). Wall schemes read as courses: plaster, brick, stone, timber, log, sci-fi panel, candy stripes, voxel blocks, paper. Add a base (plinth, steps, stilts), a porch (columns with pediment, canopy, steps), a crown (battlements, lighthouse lantern room, belfry) and a feature (chimney, windmill sails, spire, antenna, candy canes, cross). Covers cottages, huts, pagodas, temples, shops, neon shopfronts, crypts, mausoleums, sci-fi pods, lighthouses, windmills, towers, castle walls, candy and voxel houses. Colour slots: body (walls), trim, detail (roof), glow (lit windows), set with `colors`.

## `terrain.plateau`

Budget role: landmark. A raised table of land: an irregular outline extruded into a cliff skirt of stacked rock bands with ledges, a cap that overhangs and drips (grass, snow, sand, moss, icing or a glowing panel), boulders at the foot and optional glowing crystals. Use it as a rim piece, a blocker or a mesa landmark. Tune radius (1.5-8 m), height (0.6-6 m), outline shape, sides, irregularity, strata, batter, cap, cap lip, rubble, crystals and the landscape tone.

| `snow_shelf` | A long grey rock shelf under a thick dripping snow cap. |

## `terrain.ruin`

Budget role: landmark. Broken masonry: a straight wall, an L-shaped corner, a low room foundation with a doorway, a standing arch on two piers, or a colonnade of drum columns under broken beams. Walls are courses of chunky chamfered blocks; decay bites a ragged top out of them, knocks blocks askew and drops rubble; moss settles on the tops. Materials: grey stone, mossy stone, brick, marble, sandstone, obsidian with glowing cracks, candy biscuit and tech panels. Front is -Z. Tune kind, width (2-10 m), height (1.2-6 m), thickness, decay, moss, rubble and material.

| Preset | What it is |
| :-- | :-- |
| `broken_wall` | A grey stone wall with a deep ragged bite out of its top, moss on the courses and rubble at the foot. |
| `ruined_corner` | An L-shaped corner of old brick, stepped down where it has fallen. |
| `marble_colonnade` | A row of white marble columns, some snapped, with a broken beam across the standing ones. |
| `stone_arch` | A lone sandstone arch on two block piers, its keystone still in place. |
| `old_foundation` | The low mossy walls of a lost room with a doorway at the front. |
| `obsidian_gate` | A broken black obsidian arch with glowing orange cracks. |
| `tech_wall` | A fallen dark tech panel wall with glowing cyan seams. |

| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |

## `tree`

Budget role: prop. A chunky low-poly tree: a brown tapered trunk with a root flare under a crown of 1-3 tiers of faceted round lobes or stacked cones in two greens (or stacked pine tiers, or bare gnarled branches for a dead tree). Controls height, trunk thickness, branching, lean, crown size, leaf colour and bark; variant 0-7 changes tiers, round or cone crown, width, lean and colourway.
